name: Corrupted Brain Stem
summary: In Blackfathom Deeps and along Ashenvale's coast, Corrupted Brain Stem specimens come from twisted naga and satyrs. Gershala Nightwhisper of Auberdine studies the deformities caused by reckless magic. Night elf scholars hope the findings can help keep the blood elves from suffering the same fate.

sections.title: Anatomy of Transformation
sections.body: Naga and satyrs bear the marks of forbidden magic and demonic pacts. Long ago, reckless kaldorei highborne became serpent-like aquatic beasts and demonic horned fiends. Their brain stems show heavy physical mutation, proof of how deeply corruptive energies altered the nervous systems of beings who were once elves.

sections.title: Gershala's Warning
sections.body: Gershala Nightwhisper watches troubling rumors about the blood elves of the Eastern Kingdoms from Auberdine. She fears their use of demonic sorcery will create another generation of monsters on Azeroth, so she sends adventurers into Blackfathom Deeps. By examining naga and satyr tissues, she hopes to trace magical degeneration before another elven culture is lost.

faq.q: What creatures yield a Corrupted Brain Stem?
faq.answer: Naga and satyrs in Blackfathom Deeps and along the Ashenvale coast yield them, including Blackfathom oracles, sea witches, and Fallenroot satyrs.

faq.q: Who wants these brain stems and why?
faq.answer: Gershala Nightwhisper in Auberdine wants the stems for anatomical research into magical corruption.

faq.q: What are night elves hoping to learn from these specimens?
faq.answer: Night elves hope to learn how demonic energies alter elven biology. Gershala fears the blood elves may become monsters, as the ancient highborne became naga and satyrs.

faq.q: Can these be found outside of the Blackfathom Deeps caverns?
faq.answer: Yes. Some Fallenroot satyrs and Blackfathom tide priestesses outside the cavern entrance along the Ashenvale coast carry them.

angles.text: For night elves, these remains recall their people's tragic history and the monstrous effects of unchecked arcane and fel meddling.
As an Alliance scout in Ashenvale, you brave Blackfathom's depths to help Auberdine's scholars understand growing threats across Azeroth.
